# lombokclarion/cache

**Cache abstraction with file, database, array, and null drivers. Interface-first so a Redis or Memcached driver is one class away — never a core dependency.**

> **[READ-ONLY]** Subtree split of [LombokClarion](https://github.com/codinglombok/LombokClarion). Contribute to the main repository.

## Install

```bash
composer require lombokclarion/cache
```

## Namespace
LombokClarion\Cache
```php
LombokClarion\Cache
```

## Classes

- `ArrayCacheDriver`
- `Cache`
- `CacheManager`
- `DatabaseCacheDriver`
- `FileCacheDriver`
- `NullCacheDriver`
